periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 40-degree downward slope from the posterior corner toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct ventral tapering giving the patch a teardrop-like appearance with the center of mass shifted superiorly.
